- **Publish Route Provenance (ADR-0071)** — PRs #2386, #2377, #2358, #2339 — explicit publish routes classified in core; finalization moved to a pre-sign gate so dispatch is no longer conflated with success. UniFFI binding scope corrected. [...] - **Publish route provenance (ADR-0071) threaded through the write stack.** `PublishRaw` banned from starter/DX paths; routes classified by explicit provenance type. [...] 2. **Write door — publish route provenance (ADR-0071):** 🔶 in progress. Provenance threaded through the stack; finalization is now a pre-sign gate (dispatch ≠ success); `PublishRaw` banned from DX paths. **3 slices still open** (see below). [...] - **#2371** — SLICE-NS-WRITE-004: delete anonymous explicit-route defaults — `status:blocked` (depends on #2369 and #2370); remove `Default for PublishRouteClass` and `manual_override` convenience helpers once write-path invariants are in place.
- **#2372** — SLICE-NS-WRITE-005: scope pre-signed publish to imported or protocol-owned seams — `agent-ready`; remove pre-signed publish as a general app write door; retain only for Marmot/verbatim/protocol-owned seams with explicit provenance. [...] - **WRITE-004** (open, no PR) — delete the *anonymous route default* (`Default for PublishRouteClass`), so a publish can never silently route without declared provenance.
